_about: WS-61 KB-2b golden set (knowledge_base.md §21.5). Each `md` is a stored body. `saved` is what the block editor writes for it: parse and write once. Vitest (src/app/knowledge/lib/editor/editorMarkdown.test.ts) holds the editor to `saved` and to the fixed point. Pytest (tests/unit/test_kb_editor_golden.py) runs the chunker on `saved`. `nodes` and `marks` are the blocks and marks that both bodies keep.
